text:
ana-rep: Quick ask — Praxis Medical needs a hosted POC key for an in-person demo next Friday. Requirements: chat+embeddings, IP allowlist (clinic IPs), 24-48h TTL, billing tag 'poc/praxis'. Also they want a short revoke/rotation playbook for their security reviewer.

tony-eng: We can do ephemeral hosted keys. Security usually enforces 24h TTL for public-hosted. I can pre-create a standby key and drop both in 1Password. Send the 3 IPs and demo contact.

ana-rep: IPs: 198.51.100.101, 198.51.100.102, 198.51.100.103. Contact: demos@praxis.example.com. They prefer 48h but will accept 24h.

claire-sec: For the questionnaire: include Console -> Activity export (create, revoke) and a redacted screenshot of key metadata. Note: hosted keys are managed in Redwood control plane; per-tenant KMS is only available for Private/Dedicated enterprise customers. Flag as blocker if they insist on KMS.

tony-eng: API snippet I'll use (admin token redacted):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"name":"poc-praxis-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":86400,"allowlist_ips":["198.51.100.101","198.51.100.102","198.51.100.103"],"metadata":{"billing_tag":"poc/praxis","contact":"demos@praxis.example.com"}}'

ops-bot: key created: hosted_key_poc_praxis_2024  created by tony-eng  expires in 24h  scopes: chat, embeddings

ana-rep: Thanks. Please confirm where the security export lives so I can add it to the buyer packet.

claire-sec: Export from Console -> Activity -> API Keys. We log creator, allowlist, TTL, and metadata. I'll upload a redacted CSV to the deal folder after the demo.

tony-eng: Rotation/revoke playbook: 1) create ephemeral key (24h), 2) store primary+standby in 1Password, 3) if compromise call revoke endpoint, 4) post-demo revoke and attach Activity CSV. Revoke command: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_key_poc_praxis_2024/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'

ops-bot: key revoked: hosted_key_poc_praxis_2024  revoked by tony-eng  revocation_time: 1769995300

ana-rep: Great, I shared the export and the one-page playbook with the customer. Marking this POC ready. :thumbsup:
